verdict.rationale: Nitrokey ships an official CLI, nitropy, with a dedicated first-party documentation page. A runtime probe confirmed it installs from PyPI and identifies itself as 'Command line tool to interact with Nitrokey devices' (v0.13.0). Missing for 10: documented command coverage and depth, machine-readable or agent-friendly output modes, independent community corroboration of CLI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Nitrokey's official nitropy CLI installs keylessly from PyPI and identifies itself
